contract.atomicFactSet: 用户对当前未交付US Subject指定已有演员；冻结同Run/state/execution basis、People正式单人版本快照和Subject choice head期望revision；Actor Choice Intent、head、Command Receipt、marker、audit全有或全无，重放先于当前状态/People读取；不写People或Arca，不直接更改已提交Media-Cast；后续Libra按当前生产事实决定原位继续或合法replacement，Handoff B Accepted后由Arca处理
contract.rollbackInvariant: Any participant, revision fence, digest, or CAS failure leaves zero transaction writes visible; no commit marker, receipt, or outbox may survive alone.

crashFixtures.faultInjectionPoints: Run/Subject/choice revision validation, immutable Intent and head CAS, Command Receipt/marker/audit, before and after COMMIT
crashFixtures.requiredInvariant: The explicit actor choice and durable receipt are all-or-none; replay precedes later Run/People changes; no People or Arca mutation
